briefing: Markets were modestly positive but not a strong risk-on day (NASDAQ +1.1%, S&P +0.4%), so we held our seven existing positions rather than touching winners. We did add CLF and MANE, the only two candidates showing all four bullish confirmation signals together (RSI, MACD crossover, price above SMA-20, and a volume surge), filling 2 of our 3 open slots with genuinely high-conviction setups rather than deploying cash indiscriminately.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Technical confluence means multiple independent indicators — like RSI, MACD, moving averages, and volume — all point the same direction at once. When several signals agree, the odds of a real, sustained move are higher than when only one signal flashes, which is why today's buys were limited to stocks showing all four confirming signals.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 技術指標共振（Technical Confluence）是指多個獨立的技術指標——例如RSI、MACD、移動平均線和成交量——同時指向同一個方向。當多個訊號一致時，真正且持續的走勢出現的機率會比只有單一訊號時更高，這也是為什麼今天只選擇了同時符合全部四項確認訊號的股票進行買入。

market_education.summary_en: Equities drifted higher in moderate, broad-based trading with tech leading slightly ahead of the broader market. There was no single dominant catalyst reported today; the move looks more like continued grinding momentum than a reaction to a specific headline. Volume patterns in a handful of small and mid-cap names (notably CLF and MANE) suggest targeted institutional buying rather than market-wide euphoria.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日股市在溫和、普遍性的交投中小幅走高，科技股表現略勝大盤一籌。市場上未見明顯的單一催化消息，今日的上漲更像是延續性的動能推進，而非針對某則新聞的反應。部分中小型股（特別是CLF和MANE）的成交量異常放大，顯示可能有機構資金針對性進場，而非全市場性的狂熱追捧。

trades.reasoning: All four confirming signals align (RSI in bullish zone, MACD bullish crossover, price above SMA-20, volume surge) indicating genuine institutional participation.
